turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please try to rest. We will make sure everything is as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know I cannot be with you always, but I hope my teachings guide you. Take care of each other.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, please rest easy. We will make sure everything is taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I must see my son married first. Arrange it, please.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, you shall see your wish fulfilled. We will arrange the wedding soon, and you will rest knowing all is well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, ensure the maid is treated well. She has been a loyal member of our family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. Father will see to everything. I will do my best to make you proud.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, take care of our family. Ensure that the maid is provided for as well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will marry the maid as you wish. Rest easy, please.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, rest now. Your wishes will be honored, and our family will thrive under your eldest son's capable hands.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise to take care of everything as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, listen well. After I am gone, ensure the maid is treated with respect and kindness. She is family now.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, you need not worry. The maid will be treated with the respect and kindness she deserves, as if she were indeed part of our bloodline. Rest assured, your family will always be cared for.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, Father, please do not worry. I will do everything in my power to make sure the maid is well taken care of.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Thank you, sir. I will always be loyal and hardworking for the family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my dear, you must focus on getting well. We will make sure everything is taken care of, just as you wish.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will arrange the wedding immediately, as you wish. Please rest now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my children. I am relieved to see you are both so responsible. But do not forget, after I am gone, you must care for each other above all else.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my love, you must rest now. The eldest son and the maid will take care of everything, and they will always look after each other. We will ensure your final wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I know you will do your best, but I fear for the maid. She is young and will need guidance.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
